sample_unit: patients with acute ischemic stroke (discharge education drafts)

links.outcome: Blinded senior neurologist review of LLM discharge education drafts for hallucinations and acceptability
links.effect: No clear hallucinations identified during expert review, and LLM drafts had fewer unacceptable ratings than physician-written instructions.
links.quote: No clear hallucinations were identified during expert review, and LLM drafts had fewer unacceptable ratings.

unlisted_practices: Structured clinical input-guided workflow: EHR extraction mapped to deidentified case report form with manual verification before standardized prompting of the LLM

screen.reason: Empirical feasibility evaluation of a structured LLM workflow for generating acute ischemic stroke discharge instructions compared to standard physician-written instructions, evaluated by expert neurologists and patients.
